title: Split-prime supercongruence at the mixed CM point (1/6, 1/3; 1)
summary: For the mixed CM point (a,b,c) = (1/6, 1/3, 1), define A_n^{mix} := 108^n [z^n] _2F_1(1/6, 1/3; 1; z)^3. For every split prime p >= 7, p == 1 mod 3, and every m >= 1, we prove unconditionally A_{mp}^{mix} == A_m^{mix} mod p^4. The exponent 4 exceeds the generic weight-3 Hodge-gap prediction of 3; the extra factor of p is a CM enhancement attached to j=0. We also establish the matching unconditional inert-prime obstruction (p == 2 mod 3), both as a formal-parameter congruence on the q-side and as a coefficient-level Cartier parity law modulo p.
